# TheFXSoft platform — multi-tenant remittance & bureau de change software

One codebase that every money service business (MSB) and bureau de change runs on. CoRemit, Sahara Exchange and Barking FX are example tenants. A new MSB is a row in the database, not a new deployment, which is what makes "portal and app live in under 15 minutes" possible.

**This build is the demo/reference implementation.** All data lives in the browser (localStorage) and is generated by the same engine that production will use. See `docs/ARCHITECTURE.md` for how to move it onto Supabase.

## What's in it

| Area | Route | Who |
|---|---|---|
| Sign-in / persona picker | `/` | everyone (demo) |
| Super Admin | `/admin` | TheFXSoft: MSB list, approvals with KYB checklist, onboarding links, payout network, billing, audit log, "open as MSB" |
| MSB portal | `/portal` | MSB admin + staff: dashboard, transactions, payments-in matching, customers & KYC, compliance (cases, rules, auto-release, screening, SARs, policies), treasury, reports, settings (branding, corridors, roles, domain) |
| Customer app | `/app/<slug>` | senders: sign-up, KYC, recipients, full send flow with fraud check, bank-transfer payment, status tracking |
| Get started (public) | `/get-started` (`/get-started/bureau` preselects bureau) | a new MSB: choose remittance / bureau / both, then a 10-step self-service setup with live app, web-portal and admin previews and a 15-minute timer |
| Onboarding link (invited) | `/onboard/<token>` | same wizard, opened from a private link created in Super Admin |

### Transaction lifecycle
`Awaiting funds → Funds received → (rules run) → On hold / Ready to release → Sent to partner → Paid`
Rejected transfers are refunded; every step is on the transfer's timeline and in the audit log.

### Compliance engine (`src/lib/rules.js`, `src/lib/engine.js`)
- 13 rule types (amount, first transfer, velocity, cumulative, structuring, many senders, corridor, customer risk, KYC, PEP, sanctions, source of funds, young sender), each with action **flag / hold / block** and severity.
- Auto-release: transfers that pass every rule and are under the MSB's limit go to the partner without a person touching them.
- Cases with notes, assignment, decisions (release / reject & refund / clear), MLRO sign-off for blocking rules.
- Name screening (Jaro-Winkler) against a demo watchlist; PEP flagging; false-positive / true-match disposition that freezes the customer.
- Internal SARs → MLRO decision (file with NCA, DAML request with notice period, or not reported).
- Risk scoring per customer with manual override.
- Policy templates (AML/CTF, risk assessment, CDD, privacy notice, fraud guide, complaints) with versions and MLRO approval.

### Self-service onboarding (`src/pages/onboard/Onboard.jsx`)
1. Business details → 2. channels (web portal + app / app only / admin only) → 3. design (logo, colours, font, text size, roundness, light/dark, navigation — one design drives web portal **and** app) → 4. KYC provider (Didit / Shufti Pro: log in to your own account in a provider window and authorise; or name another provider at extra cost) → 5. countries + payout partner (Daytona Capital Management / Hello Paisa, same connect flow; or request another) → 6. payment processor (Fena open banking built in; other processors are requests: ~1 week standard, urgent and very urgent at extra cost) → 7. compliance release mode (automatic with AI review against uploaded AML/TM policies, or manual release by the compliance officer) → 8. customer email templates → 9. admin portal look → 10. domain, summary, declaration, launch.
Every provider step carries the disclaimer that the MSB needs its own account and agreement with the provider; TheFXSoft supplies the IT service only. Every tenant surface carries "Made by TheFXSoft Limited".

### Pricing per corridor (`corridorFee` in `src/lib/engine.js`)
Each corridor has an FX margin and two fee bands split at a threshold: below it a fixed £ plus a % of the amount; at or above it another fixed £ plus % (default £0 + 0%, i.e. larger transfers pay only the FX margin). So "PKR: 2.5%", "BDT: £2 flat", or "under £100: £3 + 1%, £100+: no fee" are all one row. Set at onboarding, edited in Settings → Corridors & pricing.

### Growth & service features (`src/lib/growth.js`)
- **Promo codes** (Settings → Promotions): no fee / % off / £ off / better rate, first-transfer-only, min amount, max uses, expiry; applied at quote, savings reported.
- **Rate alerts** + public shareable **rates page** (`/app/<slug>/rates`) with WhatsApp share text.
- **Recipient name check** (Confirmation-of-Payee style) on save, badge in app and admin.
- **Standing transfers**: weekly / fortnightly / monthly, created automatically and the customer is reminded to pay; cancel from Activity.
- **Support inbox**: customers raise queries from Help; staff reply from the Support module; replies arrive as notifications.
- **Document expiry** nudges in the app and Expiring/Expired pills plus dashboard items in admin.
- **Notifications centre** in the app (bell with unread count).
- **Plan selection** (Starter / Growth / Enterprise) in the wizard.

### Integrations (chosen at sign-up, changeable in Settings → Integrations)
- **KYC**: Didit or Shufti Pro included; custom provider quoted separately.
- **Payout**: Daytona Capital Management included; custom partners quoted separately (Super Admin → Integration requests: quote → MSB accepts → mark live).
- **Pay-in**: Fena (open banking), ClearBank, Revolut Business, EM Bank, Secure Trading, Bombora Transact365 included.

### Ledger (Treasury)
Double-entry journals per MSB (`db.journals`, `tenant.accounts`): customer payments, payouts (prefund, fee income, FX income), refunds and top-ups post automatically; expenses and transfers between accounts are manual. Trial balance and CSV export.

### Responsibility
TheFXSoft provides the software and integrations. Each MSB self-declares its FCA/HMRC status at onboarding and is responsible for its own regulatory compliance, including how it configures rules, thresholds and policies. Super Admin approval is a commercial/technical go-live checklist, not a regulatory check.

### Everything is configurable (no hard-coded lists)
Super Admin → **Platform settings** defines what the software offers: currencies and mid rates (with rate history), payout partners, KYC providers, pay-in banks, plans (fee + modules), the modules themselves, and every drop-down list (purposes, sources of funds, document types, occupations, relationships, methods, channels), plus the platform name/domain. All of it lives in `db.platform`; `src/lib/reference.js` mirrors it so components can keep importing constants.

Per MSB: modules can be switched on/off (plan or add-on), roles are fully custom (create / rename / delete, per-module access), corridors, pricing, integrations, rules, thresholds, risk weights, policies, branding and domain.

### Optional modules
- **Agents & branches**: agent logins, float accounts in the ledger (issue / collect), commission on fees, per-agent transfer list.
- **Corporate clients**: business senders with Companies House number, UBOs, monthly contract limit (enforced on every transfer), bulk payment file.
- **Bureau de change** (a product in its own right, or added to a remittance MSB): rate board (platform mid ± spread, or custom buy/sell), tills and stock per branch, cashier shifts with opening/closing counts and variance posting, wholesaler stock orders (ordered → received), deals with ID threshold and linked-deal aggregation, name screening, receipts, online reservations (click & collect at a held rate) from the customer app and a public rates page, reports (by currency, by cashier, MLR register of ID-recorded deals), all posting to the ledger.

### Products
Super Admin creates an onboarding link for **money remittance**, **bureau de change**, or both; the wizard asks only for what that product needs (a bureau: currencies held, spread, branches, opening till float, HMRC MLR; no FCA FRN, corridors or payout partners). Products can be switched on or off per business later from MSBs → Products & modules.
- **Rewards**: points per £ sent, redemption as fee credit, shown in the customer app.
- **Tracker**: staff lookup plus a public branded tracking page (`/app/<slug>/track`).
- **Developer**: API keys (shown once), signed webhooks with event selection, per-MSB audit log.

### Built-in AI
`netlify/functions/ai.mjs` calls the Anthropic API for: the assistant panel (questions over the MSB's live data), case review, policy drafting, and plain-English → rule. Without a key, the UI falls back to rule-based summaries so the demo still works.

## Run locally
```bash
npm install
npm run dev          # http://localhost:5173
```
To test the AI function locally: `npx netlify-cli dev` with `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` in a `.env` file.

## Deploy on Netlify
1. Netlify → **Add new site → Import an existing project → GitHub** → pick this repo. Build settings are read from `netlify.toml` (build `npm run build`, publish `dist`, functions `netlify/functions`).
2. **Site configuration → Environment variables**: add `ANTHROPIC_API_KEY` to switch the AI on. Optional: `AI_MODEL`, `VITE_PLATFORM_DOMAIN` (e.g. `coremit.app`) for subdomain routing.
3. Deploy. Every push to `main` redeploys.

Custom domains per MSB: add `*.coremit.app` as a wildcard domain on the site, then each MSB's own domain as an additional domain (CNAME → the site). The app resolves the tenant from the hostname (`src/lib/tenancy.js`).

## Before real money
- Replace the browser store with Supabase (schema in `supabase/schema.sql`); every engine op becomes an API call.
- Real auth (Supabase Auth with MFA), and require a staff session in the AI function; rate-limit it per tenant.
- Real KYC/liveness provider, real sanctions/PEP screening, bank feed for payments-in, partner APIs for payouts.
- Safeguarding, reconciliation and reporting reviewed with your compliance adviser. Policy templates are starting points, not legal advice.
